[[File:Naboo_Philosophers.png|thumb|right|300px|Statues of the Naboo philosophers featured in front of Theed Royal Palace]]
The '''Naboo philosophers''' were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who were generally viewed as peaceful, enlightened, and artistic. Because of this, the people of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] had an intense admiration for them. Some of these philosophers eventually became so famous and important that they were immortalized as monumental statues on the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|forecourt]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] and over the balustrade of the [[Theed Coliseum]]. This indicates they might have been worshiped within the [[Naboo religion|Naboo cult]].
